title: dactylorhiza × szaboiana
intro: Dactylorhiza × szaboiana, commonly known as Szabo's orchid, is a rare and hybrid species of orchid that belongs to the genus Dactylorhiza. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe and calm irritated tissues. The therapeutic actions of Szabo's orchid include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of Dactylorhiza × szaboiana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
